title: I am in awe of what I just experienced- the hype is real ya’ll! #Imme...
transcript: Well, I've seen it. I have seen immersive Phantom. This will be just my quick, non spoiler initial thoughts, but oh my god, that was the most insane thing I've ever experienced. Like, I don't think I've ever experienced anything at this scale of, like, technical complexity and spectacle. And I thought they did a really good job blending the old classic Phantom with this new style. So there really is something for everyone to enjoy, whether you are an old school Phantom fan or a person who's never seen Phantom before. I really don't wanna say too much because it is one of those experiences that I think is so much better if you go in completely blind. I really am just in all at what they were able to pull off. Our Phantom and Christine was Jeff Creedy and Anna Zavolson. They were both incredible. Anna's voice is just insane. Like, I really do think Anna is one of the rising stars who's gonna be a massive name in like a decade. And I've never really gotten to see Jeff perform either, but I thought he was fantastic as the Phantom. But truthfully, I've heard nothing but good things about all six cast. So whichever one you end up getting, I think you will very much enjoy it. But that's my very quick, immediate thoughts. Uh, I will post more when I get home, including some spoiler stuff. Any questions that you have, feel free to leave them In the comments. I'll try to respond to as many as I can, but I am just so happy to report that this is truly everything that I wanted it to be, and I think everyone wanted it to be. It really does live up to the hype, and I know that the 200+ price point is expensive for a lot of people, myself included, but I really do think it's worth it. Like, you can see your money that you paid for your ticket throughout the entire experience.
